.. py:data:: MONTHS_LIST
   :value: ['Janvier', 'Février', 'Mars', 'Avril', 'Mai', 'Juin', 'Juillet', 'Août', 'Septembre',...


.. py:function:: section_row(section_label: str, fields: list[tuple[float, str]]) -> None

   Displays information contained in fields input, named after section_label input,
   under the format of a 2 columns table : | section_label | field1
                                           |               | field2
                                           |               | ....
                                           |               | fieldN

   Ratios between 0 (excluded) and 1 (excluded) of trains delayed/cancelled
   are displayed as approximate proportions ("X out of Y trains").
   Very low and very high ratios are handled separately to avoid
   misleading approximations.
   Missing values, zero ratios and invalid ratios are handled separately.

   :param section_label: Label of the section, contained in the first column.
   :type section_label: str
   :param fields: list of fields, tuples containing a ratio and a status.
   :type fields: list
   :param The ratio represents the number of delayed/cancelled trains:
   :param divided by the number of planned trains over the selected period.:
   :param First field is displayed in the second column:
   :param :
   :param same line as the section_label. Other fields are stacked on the following rows:
   :param on the second column.:


.. py:function:: select_month(msg: str) -> int

   Get month from a dropdown list as integer, requiring get_month_from_str_int
   function to convert a month string to integer for further functions.

   :param msg: Message to be displayed aside the dropdown list
   :type msg: str

   :returns: Selected month as integer (bewteen 1 and 12)
   :rtype: selected_month (int)


.. py:function:: select_years(msg: str) -> list[int]

   Get year(s) from a multiselect dropdown.
   Initially, all years from the dataset are selected.

   :param msg: Message to be displayed aside the dropdown list
   :type msg: str

   :returns: Selected years from the initialized dataset.
   :rtype: selected_years (list[int])


.. py:function:: get_month_from_int_str(month_int: int) -> str

   Converts a month as integer into string.
   This is based on a dictionnary month_dict{month_int: month_str}

   :param month_int: month as integer
   :type month_int: int

   :returns: month as string
   :rtype: month_str (str)


.. py:function:: get_month_from_str_int(month_str: str) -> int

   Converts a month as string into integer.
   This is based on a dictionnary month_dict{month_str: month_int}

   :param month_str: month as string
   :type month_str: str

   :returns: month as integer
   :rtype: month_int (int)


.. py:function:: display_sidebar() -> None

   Displays sidebar containing input widgets for customer to specify
   a trip to vizualize

   :returns: array of trip infos departure_city, arrival_city,
             start_month, end_month, selected_years
   :rtype: trip_infos (np.array)


.. py:function:: display_delayed_cancelled_stats_table(col: str, departure_city: str, arrival_city: str, start_month: str, end_month: str, selected_years: numpy.ndarray) -> None

   Displays delayed and cancelled train ratios in the given column.
   The ratios are displayed as approximate fractions ("X out of Y trains").
   The statistics are the ratios computed over a given months/years period,
   for a given departure and arrival cities.

   :param col: body column number to place the table
   :type col: str
   :param departure_city: departure city to compute the statistics
   :type departure_city: str
   :param arrival_city: arrival city
   :type arrival_city: str
   :param start_month: first month of the time period for a given year
   :type start_month: str
   :param end_month: last month of the time period
   :type end_month: str
   :param selected_years: np.ndarray of selected years to
                          compute the statistics
   :type selected_years: np.ndarray
